subject: sentences
title: Words that describe
about: What a describing word tells about a thing: its color (red), its size (tiny), how many (three) or how it feels (soft). Adjectives are a row of NC's K-1 grammar continuum under L.1.1; Naming, action, describing asked him to spot a describing word, and this level asks what the describing word is telling him.
tip: Point at the thing and ask four quick questions: what color, how big, how many, how does it feel?

cards.q: Pick the word that tells how many: three big red apples.
cards.note: Three tells how many apples. Big tells the size and red tells the color.

cards.q: Pick the word that tells the size: two tiny green frogs.
cards.note: Tiny tells the size. Two tells how many and green tells the color.

cards.q: Pick the word that tells the color: a big soft gray cat.
cards.note: Gray is the color. Big tells the size and soft tells how it feels.

cards.q: Pick the word that tells how it feels: four small wet socks.
cards.note: Wet tells how the socks feel. Four tells how many and small tells the size.

cards.q: Pick the word that tells the color: five long yellow buses.
cards.note: Yellow is the color. Five tells how many and long tells the size.

cards.q: Pick the word that tells how it feels: one hot red cup.
cards.note: Hot tells how the cup feels. One tells how many and red tells the color.

cards.q: Pick the word that tells how many: six little brown eggs.
cards.note: Six tells how many eggs. Little tells the size and brown tells the color.

cards.q: Pick the word that tells the size: a big cold blue pool.
cards.note: Big tells the size. Cold tells how it feels and blue tells the color.

cards.q: Pick the word that tells how many: ten tiny black ants.
cards.note: Ten tells how many ants. Tiny tells the size and black tells the color.

cards.q: Pick the word that tells how it feels: a small soft pink pig.
cards.note: Soft tells how the pig feels. Small tells the size and pink tells the color.

cards.q: Red, blue, green. What do these words tell?
cards.note: Red, blue, and green are color words.

cards.q: Big, small, tall. What do these words tell?
cards.note: Big, small, and tall are size words.

cards.q: Two, five, ten. What do these words tell?
cards.note: Two, five, and ten are number words. They tell how many.

cards.q: Soft, wet, hot. What do these words tell?
cards.note: Soft, wet, and hot tell how a thing feels when you touch it.

cards.q: The soft cat naps. Which word tells what the cat is like?
cards.note: Soft describes the cat. Cat is a naming word and naps is an action word.

cards.q: Ben has a red bike. Which word tells what the bike is like?
cards.note: Red describes the bike. It tells the color.

cards.q: The tall tree is old. Which word tells the size of the tree?
cards.note: Tall tells the size. Old is a describing word too, but it tells how old, not how big.

cards.q: Zoe ate two warm buns. Which word tells how many buns?
cards.note: Two tells how many. Warm is a describing word too, but it tells how the buns feel.
